## Critique
- claim-1: Supported by the inspected full text `doi:10.1112/jlms.12832`, content SHA-256 `267a2f5eeae54137af99793e84d5293ec688e854ffff662ddd3a27b1334e2bbd`. Exact excerpt: “\(I_{r,n-r}=\mathrm{Span}_{\mathbb Z}\{s_\lambda\mid\lambda\nsubseteq(n-r)^r\}\)” and “\(H^*(\mathrm{Gr}_{r,n})\cong\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\)” [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-218].
- claim-2: Supported with its hypothesis and parameter definitions. The source assumes “a bigrassmannian permutation \(v=v_{r,s,t,n}\in S_n\),” defines \(i,j,a,b\), and states that \(J_v\) “is minimally generated by” the displayed lower-adjoined family [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]. The auxiliary valid-tuple hypothesis is exactly
  \[
  r<n,\quad a+j\le r,\quad a+i\le n-r,\quad b\le i,j,\quad N\le ab
  \]
  [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 301-304].
- claim-3: Correctly classified as an internal proof dependency rather than an independently source-backed claim. The external source converts a nonzero homogeneous syzygy into consistent decomposable equations [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 326-344], but the full-coordinate integral tall-to-wide repair is supplied by accepted task 292.
- claim-4: Established internally from source-backed generation and accepted task 292. The homogeneous-kernel argument, including the \(N=0\) and \(a=0\) cases, is recorded at `artifacts/internal-sources/2b115024c234b698f79f034f44a7c2dc1f1329f234fefddb8f5adc5d439434d4/artifact.txt@L77-L85`; the resulting decomposition is recorded at the same artifact, lines 88–92.
- Source limitation: inspected `source-2`, `sources/0809.2981v2.tex`, revision `source-revision-9f2d90286b159738da58b0fe0bd47f85b5597dcdbd2b987cea65817b43536281`, SHA-256 `9ddef409b3aa44eb1d31f101f3d22b364fdb5b52c404bc06529a2e3f6441bb02`, states “\(J_v:=\Bbbk\text{-span of }\{\sigma_u:u\ge v\}\)” [source-2, lines 328-337], but does not state the requested indecomposables decomposition. The inspected 2024 source likewise states minimal generation, not that decomposition.
- The absence of any \(G_L\)-to-\(G_R\) computation is explicitly recorded at `artifacts/internal-sources/2b115024c234b698f79f034f44a7c2dc1f1329f234fefddb8f5adc5d439434d4/artifact.txt@L45` and `@L87-L93`.

## Required revisions
- None identified. The scoped source certificate is established:
  \[
  J_v/A_+J_v\cong\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z[\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}].
  \]
  Claims 3–4 remain explicitly internal, and no parent-theorem or right-adjoined conclusion is asserted.
